name: doc-promise-lost-data

finding.title: `save_settings` empties the settings file on every sync, and is not atomic as its docstring says
finding.description: `open(path, "w")` truncates the settings file before `json.dumps` runs. `remember_sync` stores a `datetime` in `settings["last_sync"]`, which `json.dumps` cannot serialize, so it raises `TypeError` after the file was truncated. Every sync leaves the settings file empty and the user's saved settings are gone. The docstring also promises an atomic replace.

prDiff:
diff --git a/app/settings.py b/app/settings.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/app/settings.py
+++ b/app/settings.py
@@ -1,3 +1,15 @@
 import json
+from datetime import datetime
 
 SETTINGS_PATH = "~/.config/notes/settings.json"
+
+
+def save_settings(path, settings):
+    """Atomically replaces the settings file at `path`."""
+    with open(path, "w") as f:
+        f.write(json.dumps(settings, indent=2))
+
+
+def remember_sync(path, settings):
+    settings["last_sync"] = datetime.now()
+    save_settings(path, settings)
